packageRules.description: Confluent is boxed to 8.0.x: 8.1+ (Kafka 4.1-based) references org.apache.kafka.common.metrics.Monitorable, absent from the pinned kafka-clients 3.9 line. See the comment in gradle/libs.versions.toml; lift this when kafka-clients moves to >= 4.1.
Nano1 uses JetPack 7.2 with the CUDA 13.2 and TensorRT 10.16 runtime line. Newer NGC TensorRT images require a newer host runtime.
Apicurio Registry 3.3.1 fails the integration stack health gate. Keep the known-good 3.3.0 image until a replacement passes the full registry suite.
